subject: Re: HealthBridge reference interview — scheduling, agenda & recording consent
messages:
From: Sana Kapoor <sana@healthbridge.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@healthbridge.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthBridge reference interview — interested; availability

Hi Dylan / Marissa —

Thanks for reaching out. We’re happy to participate in a short case study about our rollout of Redwood Inference. Tom (cc'd) will probably be the primary stakeholder on the technical side; I can speak to business outcomes.

Availability next week looks good for a 30–45 minute call: Tue (10/20) 10–11am PT, Wed (10/21) 2–4pm PT, or Thu (10/22) morning. We’re also fine with a recorded session for internal use and a short quoted testimonial on the final case study, but we’d like to review the draft before anything is published.

Attached: healthbridge-logo.png (for the case study) and a quick internal consent checklist.

Two small asks on our side:
- Can you share a short agenda so we can determine who needs to join?
- Will the recording include screen share of dashboards? We prefer screenshots only where necessary and anonymized data.

Best,
Sana Kapoor
Head of Partnerships
HealthBridge.ai

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Kapoor <sana@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@healthbridge.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthBridge reference interview — agenda & recording consent

Sana — thanks so much, glad HealthBridge is up for this. Quick answers and a proposed plan below.

Agenda (30–40 minutes):
1) Introductions & roles (5 min) — confirm Tom and Sana and internal stakeholders
2) Project context & goals (5–8 min) — what you were trying to solve
3) Implementation summary (8–10 min) — timeline, infra model (dedicated vs hosted), integration highlights
4) Outcomes & metrics (8–10 min) — latency, cost, user impact, operational wins
5) Fair use & next steps (5 min) — consent, review process, publication timeline

Recording & assets:
- We will record the call for accuracy (audio + optional screenshare). We will not capture PII or raw patient data.
- We’ll share the recording and a short written draft of the case study for your review before publishing.
- Screenshots: we will only include anonymized screenshots if you approve specific images in the draft.

Proposed attendees from Redwood: me (dylan_brooks) and Marissa Cole (Customer Success). Mina Haddad (Solutions) will join if there are technical deployment questions. Please let us know any other HealthBridge stakeholders to add.

I can send a calendar invite for Tue 10/20 10:30–11:10 PT if that works — flagged as a 40-minute slot to allow for a short follow-up. Here’s a tentative calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=hb-ref-20261019

Attached is a short consent form we typically use (case-study-consent-form.pdf); it's just to make the review process explicit.

Thanks again — excited to capture HealthBridge's story.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Head of Customer Advocacy
Redwood Inference

Sana / team — I’ll own the case-study logistics. A couple of operational notes:
- We’ll record with Google Meet; I’ll set recording to drive and share a link once the call is done.
- Draft timeline: recording -> 3 business days to produce draft -> 2 business days for your review -> finalization. If you need a longer review window, we can extend.
- We usually ask for a one-paragraph quote from an executive (business outcome focused) and one technical quote (deployments/ops). If you'd prefer to supply only company-level quotes and no personal attribution, let us know.

I’m adding the consent form as an attachment here for your legal team to scan. Attachment: case-study-consent-form.pdf

If Tue 10/20 10:30–11:10 PT works, I’ll send the invite to everyone and include a brief agenda and the attendee list.

Best,
